metadata.description: Layer b: harmonic-oscillator basis matrices (r2, p2, DVR position/momentum operators, central and spin matrices)
metadata.float_format: shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 double (exact when parsed as float64); non-finite -> null
metadata.units: masses/energies GeV, r GeV^-1, p GeV

notes.op_*: ho_operator_matrix(L,beta,N,g) default rtol=1e-10, nq starts at max(64,2N) and doubles until max|cur-prev| <= rtol*max(max|cur|,1) (nq_max 8192); DVR Golub-Welsch on ho_r2_matrix(L,1,nq)
notes.mom_*: GIModel._ho_momentum_operator_matrix(L,beta,N,f) = S * ho_operator_matrix(L,1/beta,N,f) * S, S=diag((-1)^n) (continuum momentum function projected, not f of truncated p2)
notes.central_matrix_*: GIModel.oscillator_central_matrix(params,masses,L,beta,N) = K(p) + C' G~ C + S~, C=A[:,1:N], A and G~ on work basis 2N+32
notes.momentum_sandwich_contact_kernel_L0_eps_: GIModel.ho_momentum_sandwich_matrix(0,beta,N,masses,epsilon_c,smeared_contact_kernel; rtol=1e-8) WITHOUT the 32pi/(9 m1 m2) <S1.S2> strength
notes.gauss_laguerre_dvr: GIModel.gauss_laguerre_dvr(L,nbasis,nq)[1] = sqrt of nodes x_i (beta-independent); Z eigenvector signs are LAPACK-arbitrary and cancel in Z*diag(g)*Z'
